notes: MRQ-214 builds the sponsor portal and the minimal sponsors data layer it needs. Its nine acceptance criteria are ticket-local — they live in the ticket description and in sequence/sponsors-design.md §5, not in EVALUATION.md — so this ticket mints no criterion and claims ownership of none. Acceptance is demonstrated by tests/integration/sponsor-portal.MRQ-214.test.ts, tests/unit/sponsor-portal.MRQ-214.test.ts, the sponsor-Session invariants in tests/node/seed-spine.test.mjs, and the browser evidence attached to the Lattice ticket.

It deepens the existing task-machinery criteria rather than adding to them: AC-46 (the portal task list ordered by due date), AC-47 (the three task kinds), AC-48 (completion through the task machinery), AC-146 (file_config accept/maxBytes on a file request), and AC-264 through AC-266 (cancellation as a nullable tombstone, excluded from progress, with completed work never restyled). All seven now hold for two portals through one shared projection and one shared completion route instead of one.

SPEC Amendment 23 records the contract additions: speaker_tasks.completed_by_person_id and .sponsorship_id, the four sponsors tables, and §5.14 for the portal surface. The completed-by field is the amendment the ticket anticipated.

Out of scope by parent ruling, recorded so the later ticket inherits it cleanly: every organizer-side sponsor surface (Sponsors list, sponsorship record, tier settings with per-tier deliverable template sets, chase-board grouping, the People-CRM companies facet), tier-scoped portal content variation, and company logo uploads.
